title: Human Resources Business Partner
description:
**Joining NRI – Corporate Services**

Supporting People. Strengthening Performance.

Ready to shape what’s next? At NRI, we turn technology into intelligence, delivering solutions that drive measurable business outcomes. Join our team of 3,500+ local experts backed by a global network of 16,000 team members and work on projects that truly make a difference for Australia’s leading organisations.

Our People & Culture team plays a pivotal role in shaping the employee experience and enabling business success. Partnering closely with leaders across the organisation, we support our people through every stage of their career journey.

Our team brings together expertise across Learning & Development, Business Partnering, Talent Acquisition, and Resource Management to build a culture where people can thrive, teams can perform at their best, and NRI can continue to deliver outstanding outcomes for our clients

**About the Role**

You will act as the primary People & Culture advisor to an allocated Line of Business, providing expert strategic support on workforce planning, talent management, leadership capability, complex employee relations, and organisational change.

**Key Accountabilities**

* Partner with senior leaders to develop and deliver people strategies that align with business priorities and commercial outcomes
* Lead complex employee relations matters, including performance management, investigations, misconduct, grievances, and restructures
* Provide expert advice on Australian employment law, Fair Work, and industrial relations
* Support talent identification, succession planning, and leadership capability development
* Coach and oversee offshore People & Culture team members to ensure consistent, high-quality service delivery
* Drive employee engagement, culture, and experience initiatives
* Deliver workforce insights and analytics to inform strategic decision-making

**About You**

* 5+ years’ HR experience with a strong background in senior HR Business Partnering (professional services, consulting, or technology environment preferred)
* Proven ability to partner with and influence senior leaders and executives
* Extensive knowledge of Australian employment legislation and experience managing complex ER cases
* Experience leading or coaching offshore/remote HR teams
* Strong commercial acumen, strategic thinking, and change management capability
* Highly analytical with the ability to translate workforce data into actionable insights
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
* Experience with Oracle Fusion HRIS is highly desirable.

**Why Join Us?**

* Global organisation with strong local presence
* Collaborative and people-focused culture
* Opportunity to shape employee engagement, growth and development

***Take the next step with us. Apply now and make a real impact.***

*Your skills. Our impact. Together unstoppable. At NRI, you’ll work on meaningful projects, tackle complex challenges, and see the tangible difference your expertise makes. We value diverse experiences and perspectives, creating an inclusive, collaborative, and high-performing workplace. Don’t worry if you don’t meet every requirement listed - we prioritise attitude and capability, and you might be the perfect fit for this role or another within NRI.*

*NRI Australia & New Zealand is committed to building a culturally diverse and inclusive workplace and strongly encourages applications regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, sexual orientation, or disability.*

title: Senior HR Business Partner
description:
This is an opportunity to join a business at a pivotal point in its journey. Following a period of transformation and reset, the organisation is focused on growth, profitability and building the capability needed for long-term success.
  
  
We're looking for a Senior HR Business Partner who thrives on partnering with leaders, solving complex people challenges, and helping teams perform at their best. You'll have the opportunity to influence business outcomes, strengthen leadership capability, and shape the employee experience across both corporate and operational environments.
  
  
If you're someone who enjoys balancing strategic thinking with hands-on delivery, this could be the role for you.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
As part of a collaborative regional HR team, you'll support the ANZ workforce, including both corporate teams and operational employees within manufacturing and warehousing environments.
  
  
You'll be the trusted advisor leaders turn to when navigating change, building capability, improving performance, or planning for future growth.
  
  
No two days will look the same. One day you might be facilitating leadership conversations, the next reviewing succession plans, supporting operational leaders with employee relations matters, or helping shape workforce capability for the future.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Driving key people processes including performance reviews, talent calibration and remuneration cycles.
* Coaching leaders through performance, employee relations, organisational design and change management challenges.
* Building leadership capability through targeted development initiatives and practical coaching.
* Leading talent and succession planning activities to strengthen future leadership pipelines.
* Supporting operational teams across manufacturing and warehousing environments, including oversight of an existing Enterprise Agreement.
* Partnering with external providers delivering leadership and professional development programs.
* Building trusted relationships with stakeholders across all levels of the business.
* Maintaining visibility across both office and operational environments, including occasional early starts to connect with shift-based teams.

If you're an experienced HR Business Partner who enjoys building capability, partnering with leaders and driving meaningful change, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
If you are confident that your experience reflects the above criteria, please apply online quoting Ref no: 407675 or contact Ben McCormack directly on ben@tandempartners.com.au

title: Senior HR Business Partner
description:
An exciting opportunity has become available for an experienced
**Senior HR Business Partner**
to join a large, global organisation and take on a key role supporting its Australian and New Zealand operations.

Working closely with senior business leaders and reporting into the APAC HR leadership function, this is a broad and influential position combining
**strategic business partnering, people leadership and hands-on HR delivery**
.

You’ll lead a small HR team while partnering with the business across the full employee lifecycle, providing trusted advice on complex people matters and delivering initiatives across employee engagement, performance, organisational effectiveness, change and workforce strategy.

**The role**

As a senior member of the HR function, you will:

* Partner with senior leaders to understand business priorities and translate these into practical people strategies and initiatives
* Provide strategic and commercially focused HR advice across the employee lifecycle
* Lead and coach a small team of HR professionals
* Manage complex employee relations matters, including investigations, performance management, disciplinary processes and workplace issues
* Drive performance management cycles, including goal setting, reviews and feedback processes
* Lead employee engagement initiatives, analyse survey results and develop meaningful action plans
* Use workforce data, HR metrics and insights to identify trends, influence decision-making and improve business performance
* Partner with leaders to identify capability and development needs and work with specialist teams to deliver appropriate solutions
* Support annual and ad-hoc remuneration and benefits activities, taking into consideration business requirements and local market practices
* Coach managers on leadership, team dynamics, conflict resolution and people management
* Contribute to change management, organisational effectiveness and broader HR projects
* Support employees and stakeholders across Australia and New Zealand
* Collaborate with colleagues across an international, multicultural environment and multiple time zones

**About you**

We’re looking for an established HR professional who is equally comfortable discussing people strategy with senior leaders and stepping into complex operational HR matters when required.

Ideally, you will bring:

* **12+ years’ HR experience**
  , with significant experience in HR Business Partnering or a comparable senior HR position
* Strong knowledge of Australian employment practices and the ability to confidently manage complex employee relations matters
* Demonstrated experience partnering with senior business stakeholders in a large and complex organisation
* Previous experience leading or managing HR team members
* Strong capability across strategic HR, change management, employee engagement and HR analytics
* Experience across the full employee lifecycle
* Confidence using workforce data and insights to inform recommendations and influence business decisions
* Experience working within a global or multinational organisation and collaborating across cultures and time zones
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management and influencing skills
* A relevant tertiary qualification

Experience within
**technology, ICT, professional services or another large corporate environment**
will be highly regarded.

What’s on offer?

This is a fantastic opportunity to step into a visible HR leadership position within a major global organisation, with the scope to influence both day-to-day people outcomes and longer-term HR strategy.

You’ll join a collaborative HR function, partner with senior stakeholders and lead a small team while gaining exposure across Australian, New Zealand and broader APAC operations.

The role is based in
**Melbourne**
and offers a salary of
**$140,000–$150,000 + superannuation**
, with flexibility for an exceptional candidate. The position operates in a hybrid environment, with a minimum of three days per week in the office and flexibility to attend more frequently when business requirements call for it.

Some travel across Australia and New Zealand will be required.

If you’re an experienced HR Business Partner looking for a broad, senior role where you can combine strategic partnering, leadership and hands-on HR expertise, we’d love to hear from you.

**Apply now or contact Katya Kurnoskina for a confidential discussion on 03 8632 9964 or kkurnoskina@dfp.com.au.**

title: HR Business Partner
description:
The primary HR representative for the Australian business with responsibility for delivering effective people management, employee relations, talent, performance and compliance support. The role partners closely with local management while aligning Australian people practices with regional and global HR strategies. Some HR administrative support will be provided in India.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

* **Strategic HR partnership —**
  act as a trusted advisor on people, culture, organisational effectiveness, and workforce planning, providing local insights and recommendations. Championing culture & employee engagement.
* **Employee Relations & Workforce Management —**
  manage employee relations matters, provide coaching and guidance to managers, minimising risk through proactive intervention and advice.
* **Talent Acquisition & Onboarding —**
  lead end-to-end recruitment process, partnering with hiring managers to define requirements and recruitment strategies, supporting onboarding activities.
* **Performance, Learning & Development —**
  coaching leaders on performance management and development planning, supporting succession and talent reviews and facilitating annual processes.
* **Compensation & Benefits —**
  supporting salary review, bonus, and remuneration processes in collaboration with the wider HR & finance team, providing local market insights.
* **HR Operations & Compliance —**
  ensuring compliance with country and state local employment legislation and company policies, managing HR policies and procedures.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

An experienced HR partner — integrity & professionalism, relationship management, adaptable

Essential

* 5+ years’ progressive HR generalist and business partnering experience within an SME environment.
* Strong working knowledge of Australian employment compliance matters.
* Degree qualification in HR, Business, Psychology, OD, or any subject with a relevant HR certification.

Desirable

* Experience working within a matrix reporting structure and international organisation.
* Exposure to HR projects and organisational change initiatives.
